lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank, organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice across the visible portion of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular indentation or notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, highlighted by an artificial white arrow pointer.
other_distinctive_markers: A non-biological white arrow graphic is overlaid on the image, directed at a specific point on the pectoral fin margin.
